WITH RECURSIVE chain(bid) AS (
           SELECT @start
           UNION
           SELECT b.parent_id FROM branches b JOIN chain c ON b.id = c.bid
           WHERE b.parent_id <> @mainId
         )
         SELECT p.id, p.op_blob, p.origin_ts AS ts
         FROM package_ops p
         JOIN op_branches ob ON ob.op_id = p.id
         WHERE ob.branch_id IN (SELECT bid FROM chain)
           -- An ancestor's WIP stays its own: only the branch itself contributes uncommitted
           -- ops to the view; parents contribute what they committed.
           AND (ob.branch_id = @start OR p.commit_hash IS NOT NULL)
         -- `p.id`, not `p.rowid`: rowid is ARRIVAL order, which is a fact about this machine, so
         -- two stores holding the same ops applied them in different orders whenever two stamps
         -- tied exactly, and showed different code. An op id is a content hash, so this order is
         -- the same everywhere.
         --
         -- The FOLD's tie-break is finer still (`Lww.isStale` compares the bound item's hash), so
         -- the sort below re-orders what this returns. The stamp is selected only to sort by and
         -- then dropped, which is why the signature is unchanged.
         ORDER BY p.origin_ts, p.id

WITH stale AS MATERIALIZED (
       SELECT t.depends_on_owner AS o, t.depends_on_modules AS m, t.depends_on_name AS n,
              t.depends_on_hash AS h, cur.item_hash AS ch, cur.item_type AS ct, cur.rowid AS crow
       FROM (SELECT DISTINCT depends_on_owner, depends_on_modules, depends_on_name, depends_on_hash
             FROM package_dependencies WHERE depends_on_owner IS NOT NULL) t
       JOIN locations cur
         ON cur.owner = t.depends_on_owner
        AND cur.modules = t.depends_on_modules
        AND cur.name = t.depends_on_name
        AND cur.unlisted_at IS NULL
       WHERE cur.item_hash <> t.depends_on_hash)
     SELECT l.owner, l.modules, l.name, l.item_type,
            pd.depends_on_owner AS d_owner, pd.depends_on_modules AS d_modules,
            pd.depends_on_name AS d_name, pd.depends_on_item_type AS d_type,
            pd.depends_on_hash AS using_hash, s.ch AS current_hash,
            s.ct AS current_type
     FROM stale s
     CROSS JOIN package_dependencies pd
     CROSS JOIN locations l
     WHERE pd.depends_on_owner = s.o AND pd.depends_on_modules = s.m
       AND pd.depends_on_name = s.n AND pd.depends_on_hash = s.h
       AND l.item_hash = pd.item_hash AND l.unlisted_at IS NULL
     ORDER BY l.owner, l.modules, l.name, l.item_type, l.rowid,
